{{Quote|Destroy as many helper droids as you can. And do not overlook the helper droid queen. I don't know what her purpose is, but it cannot bring anything but darkness and chaos to our lives. Destroy her as well.|[[Draykken Bender]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RAL" />}}
'''QU3-3N''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the helper droids, a unique variant of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] which would give people repetitive advice on their respective professions. QU3-3N was unique, in that unlike her minions, she was much larger in size. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], QU3-3N was leading the production of helper droids from a [[Helper droid factory|droid factory]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> she was deemed a monstrosity which had to be destroyed at all costs by [[Draykken Bender]], a leader of the [[Meatlumps]], a group technology-hating [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]].<ref name="SWG:RAL" /> Bender tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with destroying QU3-3N. The spacer therefore fought the helper droids in the droid factory and finally destroyed QU3-3N.<ref name="SWG:RAL" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|[bloop... zonk] qu3-3n, qu3-3n, qu3-3n.|The incessant droning of QU3-3N, as she fell under attack.|<ref name="SWG:RAL" />}}
QU3-3N was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:RAL" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> QU3-3N was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
